channel.title: SV7FSG DX News
channel.description: DXpeditions, special event stations and contests, with dates, bands and QSL info.

item.title: SX602N Greece – frigate HS Nearchos 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: A Greek group is on the air as SX602N to mark the raising of the Greek flag on the Hellenic Navy's new frigate HS Nearchos (F602). An award (HS Nearchos Award) is available; see the RAAG page for dates and QSL details.

item.title: TO9W Saint Martin 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [29 Nov 2026 – 11 Dec 2026] A team of eight US operators (K9EL, W9MR, W9AP and others) returns to the French side of St Martin as TO9W. They plan 160–6m on all the main modes, a good chance for a Caribbean contact on the low bands.

item.title: J38W Grenada 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [22 Nov 2026 – 2 Dec 2026] J38W will be active from Grenada in the Caribbean on CW, SSB and digital modes, 160–10m, likely including CQ WW DX CW. The QSL route has not been announced yet.

item.title: OX7AM Greenland 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 23 Nov 2026 – 7 Dec 2026] OX7AM will be on the air from Greenland for about two weeks, including CQ WW DX CW. From Greece the path runs close to the pole, so look for it when 20m and 15m are in good shape.

item.title: ARRL 160-Meter Contest 2026: dates, bands & DXpeditions to work
item.description: [4 Dec 2026 – 6 Dec 2026] From Friday 4 Dec 2200 UTC to Sunday 6 Dec 1559 UTC, CW only on 160m. DX stations work only W/VE (no DX-to-DX), so it is a good test of your 160m antenna across the Atlantic.

item.title: SX200H Ermoupoli, Syros 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [1 Nov 2026 – 30 Nov 2026] The Cyclades Amateur Radio Association marks 200 years since Ermoupoli on Syros was founded and named, using the special call SX200H. A team of ten operators is active on HF throughout November, so there is still time to log it.

item.title: A31W Vava'u, Tonga 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 21 Nov 2026 – 29 Nov 2026] The Tongan Paradise Contesters (W6NV, K0AV, K7TD) are building a Multi-2 station on Vava'u for CQ WW DX CW. Before the contest they will test 160m and 6m propagation under their own calls A31WW, A31AV and A31TD.

item.title: VK9DS Cocos Is. and Christmas Island 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [20 Nov 2026 – 4 Dec 2026] VK9DS will be active first from Cocos (Keeling) Islands from 20 to 27 November, then from Christmas Island from 28 November to 4 December. Two sought-after Indian Ocean entities in two weeks, with logs uploaded after the trip.

item.title: 5R8IC Ste Marie Island, Madagascar 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [25 Oct 2026 – 20 Dec 2026] F6ICX is active as 5R8IC from Ste Marie Island, Madagascar, until 20 December, mostly on CW. A good chance for Madagascar and IOTA AF-090, with confirmation via LoTW.

item.title: RS0ISS – ARISS ISS – Lyceum No. 35, Kazan 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [20 Nov 2026] On Friday 20 November at 15:15 UTC, students of Lyceum No. 35 in Kazan will talk directly with cosmonaut Sergey Teteryatnikov aboard the ISS (RS0ISS). The 145.800 MHz FM downlink can be heard across the station's footprint, so try to receive it.

item.title: A35TV Tonga 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [28 Nov 2026 – 4 Dec 2026] An international team that includes three Greek operators (SV0EG, SV1DAY, SV1GE) alongside VK2IR, VK3YP and HB9EB will be on the air from Tonga. Activity kicks off with CQ WW DX CW, so listen out for this Pacific operation.

item.title: XR0Z Juan Fernández Is. 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [25 Nov 2026 – 6 Dec 2026] CE3VTZ and XQ7I are heading to remote Alejandro Selkirk Island in the Juan Fernández group. A rare IOTA and a sought-after entity from Europe, with activity also during CQ WW CW.

item.title: 5X7W Uganda 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [8 Nov 2026 – 29 Dec 2026] SM0HPL is already QRV from Uganda for several weeks, using slow CW that is friendly to newer operators. He will also be in CQ WW DX CW and occasionally runs QRP as 5X1Q.

item.title: ZD7WP / ZD7VJ St Helena 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [22 Nov 2026 – 5 Dec 2026] G4BWP (ZD7WP) and 5Z4VJ (ZD7VJ) will operate from St Helena in the South Atlantic on all HF bands including 60m. The island is often workable from Greece, making this a good chance for a band or mode slot.

item.title: XX9TXN Macau 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [24 Nov 2026 – 3 Dec 2026] Italian operator I2VXJ will be QRV from Macau, focusing on the low bands. He plans a single-band entry in CQ WW DX CW.

item.title: VK9XY Christmas Island 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [16 Nov 2026 – 4 Dec 2026] A youth-focused DXpedition with young operators from several countries, run by the Pacific Islands DXpedition Group with Youth on the Air. They'll also be on during CQ WW DX CW, a great chance to log this island.

item.title: C8K Mozambique 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [10 Nov 2026 – 20 Nov 2026] A Czech team is already on the air from Mozambique. SSB has recently started too, with signals on 20m.

item.title: 3X4U Guinea 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [11 Nov 2026 – 24 Nov 2026] Activity from Guinea focusing on the classic modes. ON9CFG is the pilot station.

item.title: ZK3ZL Tokelau 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [approx. 18 Nov 2026 – 1 Dec 2026] The team travels by ferry from Samoa and will spend about two weeks on the atoll with multiple HF stations. Exact dates are still to be announced.

item.title: C56XA The Gambia 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [17 Nov 2026 – 1 Dec 2026] G3XAQ will be QRV from The Gambia.

item.title: 3B8/E70A Mauritius 2026: dates, bands, QSL info
item.description: [20 Nov 2026 – 3 Dec 2026] E70A, a well-known DXpeditioner, will be QRV from Mauritius.

item.title: CQ WW DX CW 2026: dates, bands & DXpeditions to work
item.description: [28 Nov 2026 – 29 Nov 2026] One of the biggest CW contests of the year. Many DXpeditions will be active, so it's a chance for new countries.
